verdict.rationale: Sumsub docs confirm a webhooks system that automatically notifies on applicant verification events and even supports gradual rollout to production endpoints, satisfying the core 'no polling' requirement. However, the evidence never explicitly confirms webhook payloads are cryptographically signed nor lists the specific lifecycle event names (created, processing, verified, requires-input). Missing for 10: explicit signature/verification mechanism documentation, explicit enumeration of lifecycle event types.
